title: Watch: Presenter battles strong winds as storm hits Newquay
description: BBC lead weather presenter Simon King is in Newquay as the "full force" of the storm arrives.

title: Detective raped by colleague says Met handling of case 'like being raped again'

title: Ukraine says Starlink still restricted after Trump says limits lifted
description: Ukraine relies on Starlink for a range of military uses - its owner Elon Musk has repeatedly denied restricting access.

title: Raye wins the Mercury Prize with This Music May Contain Hope

title: First personalised cancer vaccine cuts risk of disease returning in major trial

title: Prince William makes surprise appearance on Graham Norton Show

title: Lights will stay on this winter, grid operator says after concerns
description: The assurance from the National Energy System Operator comes amid concern from its engineers about their ability to ensure adequate supply.
